items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: And the next thing I know he just started asking me — he started sending me on subs.

ctx.x: Yeah I liked it, yeah I definitely liked it. I was impressed. It was like revolutionary. It seems like — well I’ve read Elvin played polyrhythms, one rhythm against another rhythm and so forth, and it did kind of sound like that actually. At the same time it still was rooted in the tradition of Max Roach, Art Blakey, Jo Jones and so forth. But it was like nothing I had ever heard before. It was kind of revolutionary to me. He seemed to incorporate all the drums more than anybody had before into his total persona.…
